claims.claim: 2 units of bicycle with different prices
claims.evidence: Witness confirms 2 adult bicycles in Photo 0, but does not show any pricing or evidence of different prices.
Witness notes visible dirt/road wear; cleanliness/affordability is not measurable from the report.
No receipt, serial/date markings, or proof of purchase age shown in the report.
Witness does not report brake/gear testing or readable gear components; only general appearance is described.
Witness mentions dirt/road wear but does not confirm rust status; no close-ups of frame/metal joints.
No component-level verification (e.g., drivetrain, brake types, replacement parts) is shown.

risks.risk: Brake effectiveness and safety (pads/rotors/drums condition, cable stretch, brake alignment) are unknown from the report.
risks.proof: A short video clip of a test: rider applies both brakes firmly from low speed and the bike stops straight (front and rear), plus close-up of brake pads/condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used bicycles with unknown working brakes (worst-case: needs brake service/parts).

risks.risk: Gear system condition (shifters, derailleurs, cassette/chain wear, indexing) is not verifiable; witness says gears are not readable.
risks.proof: A clip showing shifting through all gears while stationary and then riding, with clear view of shifters/derailleurs and chain movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bicycles with unknown/possibly faulty gears (worst-case: gear tune-up or drivetrain wear).

risks.risk: Tire and tube health (tread depth, sidewall cracks, punctures, tube condition) is not assessed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires/sidewalls and a clip showing tires inflated and spinning; include tread-depth view and any puncture repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bicycles with tires of unknown condition (worst-case: tire/tube replacement).

risks.risk: Wheel trueness and rim condition (bent rims, wobble) are not checked.
risks.proof: A clip of wheel spin showing wobble (front and rear) and close-up of rim edges for dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bicycles with unknown wheel alignment (worst-case: wheel truing/rim replacement).

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional accessories/parts (lights, reflectors, pedals, basket attachment security) are not confirmed.
risks.proof: A full walk-around photo set showing: pedals, reflectors, lights (if present), basket mounting points, and all fasteners; plus a clip showing basket stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bicycles missing/uncertain accessories (worst-case: some parts not included or not working).

risks.risk: Frame size and wheel size unknown, which affects fit and resale value.
risks.proof: Photos showing frame size marking (if any) and wheel size marking (e.g., 26/27.5/29) or a tape-measure shot of wheel diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic adult used bicycles with unknown sizing (worst-case: less desirable size/fit).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of brake components (front/rear) and a short brake test video (stop straight from low speed).
Send a shifting test video: shift through all gears while stationary and while riding; show shifters and derailleurs clearly.
Send close-up photos of tires and sidewalls (tread and any cracks) plus a clip of wheels spinning to check wobble.
Send photos confirming all included parts: pedals, reflectors, lights (if present), and basket mounting points; include a clip showing basket stability.
Send wheel size and frame size proof (markings or tape-measure shot).
If claiming 'bought new 6 months ago', share receipt or any date/serial proof.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies two adult bicycles with similar white frames, baskets, drop handlebars, and front suspension, so the item type can be priced at a worst-case used condition. However, working condition details (brakes/gears/tires/wheels) are not proven, so the price should assume potential service needs until the requested proof is provided.
